comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: This phenomenon can be discovered at West Coast landing point. Go to the Stacked Boulders in the north-center of the map. Position yourself between the Stacked Boulders and the closest cliff wall to the west. The Dust Devil will appear on top of the cliff during a sunny day.

comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: I noticed a typo in my previous post. The discovery is located at West Indian Coast landing.
